tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Sam wants to talk about holiday postcard. which place to visit. what to do. when to come.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Sam.

promptBlocks.subject: Holiday news
paragraphs: I am writing about holiday postcard. which place to visit? what to do?
when to come? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Sam and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: holiday postcard
ketImageBrief.panel1: Sam starts holiday postcard with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Sam solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
